properties.title: Firefighters Respond to Chemical Drum Incident at Flex-N-Gate
properties.summary: On December 14, firefighters were called to Flex-N-Gate after discovering a chemical drum exhibiting abnormal swelling. The incident prompted a thorough preventive response, which ultimately confirmed that there was no toxic danger to the surrounding area.

properties.title: New ERISA Lawsuit Filed Against Flex-N-Gate and United of Omaha
properties.summary: A new lawsuit has been filed against Flex-N-Gate Texas, LLC and United of Omaha Life Insurance Company by Sheri Heffron, focusing on issues related to the ERISA Employee Benefits law. The case, which has drawn attention due to its implications for employee rights, was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Michigan and is presided over by Judge Paul L Maloney.

properties.title: Deputy Grangier Critiques Flex-N-Gate Job Cuts and Timing of Announcement
properties.summary: Géraldine Grangier, a deputy from the Rassemblement National party, has voiced her concerns regarding the recent voluntary departure plan at Flex-N-Gate, highlighting the negative impact of job cuts on the local community. She criticized the timing of the announcement, which coincides with the summer holidays, and pledged her support to workers and unions, urging for greater accountability in the use of public aid.

properties.title: Flex-N-Gate Announces New Employment Program Amid Redundancy Plans
properties.summary: Flex-N-Gate's European director, Brad Delorme, announced a new APLD Rebond program aimed at maintaining employment levels, which is supported by the state. This announcement coincided with a notification to unions about a voluntary redundancy plan that was not included in the official meeting agenda, raising concerns about transparency and timing before the summer holidays.

properties.title: Court Rules in Favor of Flex N Gate in COVID-19 Employment Case
properties.summary: The U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan has ruled in favor of Flex N Gate Detroit, LLC, granting their motion for summary judgment in a case brought by Jennette Shannon. The court dismissed her claims under the Michigan COVID-19 Employment Rights Act, citing the refusal to consider affidavits that contradicted previous sworn testimony.

properties.summary: Two men sentenced for drug trafficking in Ajaccio

properties.title: Flex-N-Gate Faces Lawsuit Over Unpaid Overtime Claims
properties.summary: A new lawsuit has been filed in the District of Delaware against multiple Flex-N-Gate entities, alleging violations of the Fair Labor Standards Act. Plaintiffs CALIB GRAY and LORENZO FREDERICK claim they were not compensated for overtime hours worked, raising significant concerns about wage practices within the company.

properties.title: Flex-N-Gate Workers Vote to Unionize Amid Allegations of Anti-Union Tactics
properties.summary: Workers at Flex-N-Gate Texas, LLC in Chicago have voted to form a union with the United Auto Workers, with a tally of 195 in favor and 126 against. This decision comes amid allegations of anti-union tactics employed by the company, and the union's formation is pending approval from the National Labor Relations Board.

properties.title: Federal Court Takes Up Genetic Privacy Case Against Flex-N-Gate
properties.summary: The case Christopher Shepherd and Bryant Davis v. Flex-N-Gate has been transferred to federal court, raising significant legal questions regarding the Genetic Information Privacy Act. This move highlights the ongoing scrutiny of employer practices in handling genetic information during the hiring process.

properties.title: Sixth Circuit Ruling on Workplace Safety in Joy Sampson Case
properties.summary: A recent ruling by the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit in the case of Joy Sampson v. Flex N Gate Nine Mile, LLC has introduced significant legal precedents regarding workplace safety and employee rights. This decision could have far-reaching implications for similar cases in the future, as it addresses critical issues surrounding employer liability and employee protections.

properties.title: Flex-N-Gate Workers Vote to Unionize Amid Industry Momentum
properties.summary: Workers at Flex-N-Gate Seeburn in Beaverton, Ontario have voted to join Unifor, marking a significant step in their fight for better working conditions. Over 100 employees participated in the vote, reflecting a growing trend among auto parts workers in Ontario to seek union representation in response to issues like inadequate wages and health concerns. This unionization effort highlights the increasing momentum for workers' rights in the automotive industry.

properties.title: Stellantis CEO Aims to Internalize Production Amid Job Security Concerns
properties.summary: Carlos Tavares, CEO of Stellantis, is pushing to internalize production from Flex-N-Gate back to the company's workforce in Audincourt, as confirmed by Bradley Delorme, vice-president Europe of Flex-N-Gate. This announcement follows persistent rumors and worries from the local union CGT regarding job security and the future of production in the region.

properties.title: Legal Action Filed Against Flex-N-Gate by Plaintiffs
properties.summary: Bryant Davis and Christopher Shepherd have initiated legal proceedings against Flex-N-Gate Plastics LLC and its affiliates in a federal court in Illinois. This lawsuit marks a significant development in the ongoing scrutiny of the company's practices.

properties.title: Sixth Circuit Affirms Ruling in Favor of Flex N Gate in Discrimination Case
properties.summary: The Sixth Circuit Court has upheld a ruling favoring Flex N Gate in a case brought by former employee Joy Sampson, who alleged sex discrimination and retaliation. The court found that Sampson did not provide sufficient evidence to support her claims, affirming the company's justification for her termination and the denial of a job opportunity.
